data.define: Used when you don't know the answer.

misuse.text: Don't say 'beats me' to a client's question.

data.l1_hook: Di mana kunci itu pergi? "beats me".

native.tip: “beats me” = saya tidak tahu. Contoh: “Where's the key? Beats me.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “beats me”?
“beats me” = saya tidak tahu.
Contoh: “Where's the key? Beats me.” (Di mana kuncinya? "beats me".)
